## Progress

- [PR #56](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/56) (stacked on #57): /region with the designed copy and India/UAE cards (no JavaScript); "Continue in {region}" goes to that country's own sign-up address (PublicSite:Deployments:SignUpUrls) or, if the country is not live, to a waitlist (contact fields only) stored in the Leads module
- Tenant.CountryCode and ResidencyRegion are init-only and EF throws on any later change (domain, EF and SQL Server tests, mutation-checked); copy translated (en/hi/ar); browser-verified (axe clean, keyboard, RTL); Lighthouse mobile 100 (local)
- Review fixes ([PR #67](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/67)): waitlist refuses control characters in the name and has its own anti-forgery test; the form quota counts an IPv6 subscriber (/64), not each address
- Left: record the selection in the onboarding audit trail and check the new tenant's country against the deployment when the tenant is created (MDV-P1-004); configure the live country's sign-up address once onboarding and the launch deployment exist (MDV-P0-003, MDV-P0-007)

## Description

"Where do you practise?" with India (Azure Central India · DPDP Act · ABDM integration available) and UAE (Azure UAE North · separate deployment · DoH/DHA/MOHAP per emirate) cards. Explains data stays in-country and cannot be moved later without a new account and export. "Continue in {region}" routes sign-up to that country's deployment; if a country is not yet live, it captures interest instead.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Selecting a region and continuing creates the tenant only in that country's deployment; tenant.country_code and residency_region are immutable afterwards (domain test).
- [ ] **AC2.** The residency explanation text matches the design and is translated.
- [ ] **AC3.** If the selected country deployment is not live, the user sees a waitlist form (no PHI) instead of sign-up.
- [ ] **AC4.** The selection is recorded in the onboarding audit trail.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
